narrative: On the board. The foot of the last sheet, the couplet just wet. Gib has not moved onto this sheet. He is still on the chronicle. On the board. A line ruled under the couplet. Nothing written beneath the rule. On the board. The margin, beside the rule, has the count of days and not a sum of money.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the couplet and ruled the line.
